National Testing Agency Sacks 47 Officials Amid Protests and Vacancies

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has sacked 47 officials following nationwide student protests. The government stated that 15 of the 39 permanent posts within the NTA remain vacant. This action is part of a larger effort to reform the agency, with further cleanup expected. Student groups have also called for the abolition of the NTA.
